downloadable_stories.title: The Clockmaker's Secret
downloadable_stories.description: An old clockmaker in Vienna discovers a hidden room inside his own shop after repairing a mysterious pocket watch left by a stranger.

downloadable_stories.title: The Wrong Address
downloadable_stories.description: A letter arrives at Mia's apartment addressed to someone who hasn't lived there in thirty years. Instead of returning it, she opens it — and finds a map to something hidden inside her own walls.

downloadable_stories.title: Sunday Soup
downloadable_stories.description: Every Sunday, Oscar makes soup alone in his small kitchen — the same soup, the same way his wife taught him. One Sunday, his new neighbor knocks to borrow salt. She stays for the whole afternoon.

downloadable_stories.title: The Night Shift
downloadable_stories.description: Nora has worked the overnight shift at the hospital for ten years. She knows how to read the quiet. But the patient in room 14 — with no name on his chart — is a kind of quiet she has never encountered before.
